description: This file defines the KpiModel class, which is a model representing KPI (Key Performance Indicator) data in the OrangeHRM Performance plugin API. It implements data serialization and transformation methods, utilizes traits for service access and serialization, and is responsible for preparing KPI data for external use.

classes.name: KpiModel
classes.description: A model class for KPI entities used in the API, supporting serialization to array and including KPI details along with deleteability status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a KPI entity and sets up filters and attribute names for serialization.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the KPI model to an array, including the deletable status fetched from the KPI service.
